## Downloads

| Table | One row is | File |
|---|---|---|
| Restaurants | a restaurant | [restaurants_tagged.csv](https://github.com/MedhaDev/state-college-food/blob/main/data/clean/restaurants_tagged.csv) |
| Opening hours | an opening window on one day | [restaurant_hours.csv](https://github.com/MedhaDev/state-college-food/blob/main/data/clean/restaurant_hours.csv) |
| Locations | a restaurant | [restaurant_locations.csv](https://github.com/MedhaDev/state-college-food/blob/main/data/clean/restaurant_locations.csv) |
| Calendar | a day | [calendar_days.csv](https://github.com/MedhaDev/state-college-food/blob/main/data/clean/calendar_days.csv) |
| Penn State events | an event, with its source | [psu_events_2026_27.csv](https://github.com/MedhaDev/state-college-food/blob/main/data/reference/psu_events_2026_27.csv) |
| Reddit mentions | a restaurant | [reddit_mentions.csv](https://github.com/MedhaDev/state-college-food/blob/main/data/clean/reddit_mentions.csv) |

## Data dictionary

```{python}
#| output: asis
# The dictionary lives in docs/data_dictionary.md so it also reads well on GitHub.
# Here it is shown one heading level down, with $ signs escaped so they aren't read as math.
import re
from pathlib import Path

text = (Path("..") / "docs" / "data_dictionary.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = text.split("\n", 1)[1]                      # drop the "# Data Dictionary" title
text = re.sub(r"^(#+) ", lambda m: "#" + m.group(1) + " ", text, flags=re.M)
text = text.replace("$", r"\$")
print(text)
```
